parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 How did Carrie hurt her leg?

Boy: Hi, Carrie. Are you OK?

Carrie: My leg hurts a bit, that’s all.

Boy: Oh, you were in the running race yesterday and you nearly fell, didn’t you?

Carrie: Yes, but actually I hurt my leg when I was coming down the stairs at home.

Boy: Ouch! I hurt mine quite badly when I fell off my bike when we went cycling together.

2 Which backpack has the boy bought?

Girl: Is that a new backpack?

Boy: Yes. Remember I was looking at some online with one big pocket on the outside?

Girl: Yes, and with a picture of a star.

Boy: Well, I saw this one in the market. It’s the same except it’s got two small pockets instead of one big one.

Girl: Yeah. I might get one, too.

3 Where will Daisy have her birthday party?

Boy: Daisy, have you decided to have your birthday party in your garden like last year?

Daisy: Mum said I should have it at the sports club because I want to invite a lot of my friends.

Boy: But what about food? There isn’t a restaurant there.

Daisy: Exactly, so, actually, Mum’s agreed to do the same as last year.

4 Which job does Dylan’s dad do now?

Girl: I saw your dad at the hospital yesterday, Dylan. He was helping an old lady. Is he a doctor?

Dylan: He works at the hospital, but he drives an ambulance. He loves his job.

Girl: Has he always had that job?

Dylan: He was an office worker before. He did that for a long time, but he said it was boring.

5 What did they both do yesterday?

Boy: It was great at the beach yesterday, wasn’t it? Why didn’t you come sailing?

Girl: I didn’t have enough time. I had to be home by four o’clock. But I loved going surfing.

Boy: That was the best thing for me, too. Shall we play beach volleyball next time?

Girl: Yes, that’s one of my favourite sports!
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Woman: Please listen because I want to tell you about the next class trip. We’re going to a castle. You read about this one in Tedbury last week in your history lesson. Tell your parents they need to pay for the trip this week. It’s five pounds sixty. That’s three pounds for the ticket and the rest is for transport.

This trip’s on a Saturday. We don’t want you to miss a school day, like a Friday.

We’re going by bus. Please get to school by eight fifty at the latest because the bus will go at ten past nine exactly.

You don’t need to bring paper or a pen, but you’ll need a camera. If you haven’t got one, you can share with a friend.

While we’re there, we’re going to see a special exhibition. The one about cars has just finished and now there’s one about clothes that’s called Modana. That’s M-O-D-A-N-A. It’s very interesting to see what people wore hundreds of years ago.

Now, any questions ... (fade)
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Nadia: Hi, Tom. We start our new school next week.

Tom: Yes, how are you going to get there, Nadia?

Nadia: It’s not far, so I don’t need to take a bus. I’ll cycle because I’ll have too many heavy books to walk there.

Tom: I’ve got my new uniform.

Nadia: Me too! My jacket’s fantastic!

Tom: The blue shirt’s best, I think. Not boring like the trousers!

Nadia: There are a lot of students in the new school.

Tom: I know the number exactly. Mum told me: one thousand and fifty-five. Our old school only had around eight hundred.

Nadia: My first school only had about four hundred and seventy-five children.

Tom: Chemistry is a new subject for us.

Nadia: Yes, I don’t know if I’ll like it, but I love maths, so I think I will. Will we study biology?

Tom: I’m not sure. We’ll find out on our first day.

Nadia: Oh yeah, we’ll talk to all our teachers before we go to our class. In the second week, they’ll show us how to use the library. There’ll be a quiz about it.

Tom: Great!
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a teacher talking about a trip. What has changed?

Man: Right. You know the museum trip’s next Friday and you have to be at school at eight thirty because the bus departs at eight forty-five. The bus can’t leave any later because the traffic will be bad. I’d asked you all for ten pounds, but our group tickets are cheaper, so you only have to give me eight. OK?

17 You will hear two students talking about a problem. Where’s the boy’s phone?

Girl: Why didn’t you text me to say you’d be late?

Boy: Sorry, I couldn’t. I was secretly looking at my phone in chemistry, and Ms Clements saw me, and took it and put it in her drawer. I can’t have it back until lunchtime.

Girl: Are you going home for lunch?

Boy: Yes, because I’ve left my maths books in my brother’s backpack.

18 You will hear a boy talking about buying some boots. Why did he buy the boots?

Boy: I got some new boots at the weekend. They’re the same as the ones that singer Jason Wright’s wearing in his latest video. How cool is that? The leather’s a bit hard and uncomfortable, but Mum says it’ll get softer when I wear them. They only have them in gold or brown. Mum made me have the brown ones!

19 You will hear a girl talking about playing tennis. How does she feel after playing?

Girl: You’ll never guess what happened during my tennis match! We played doubles and the girl I was playing with never let me hit the ball. I’m so mad at her. I know I won’t be able to sleep tonight because I’ll be thinking about what to say to her tomorrow. I don’t even want to have supper now!

20 You will hear two friends talking about a new teacher. What do they like about the new teacher?

Girl: Have you seen our new music teacher, Mr Martinez?

Boy: He smiles a lot, which is great.

Girl: And always wants to help you. I think he looks like that guy who plays for Manchester United.

Boy: Really? I don’t think so. Mr Martinez says he didn’t always get good grades at school and only became a teacher when he was forty.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Uncle: Are you reading that book for school, Jade?

Jade: Yes. It’s called The Delay. It’s about chemistry and there’s lots of good information I can use for my school project.

Uncle: Oh, so it isn’t a story?

Jade: Not really, but the last book we read at school was. It was called Crunch and it was great. I finished it too quickly – in an hour! I wanted to read it for days!

Uncle: Have you read any more good books?

Jade: Yes, our teacher gave us My Island. It really made me laugh a lot. I wasn’t bored reading it at all.

Uncle: Didn’t you read Dangerous Animals?

Jade: Yes, it’s not scary! But it was difficult to read – there were lots of words I didn’t know.

Uncle: OK.

Jade: I also read The Invitation. I cried when I read that, especially the beginning bit.

Uncle: Did you finish it?

Jade: Yes, and I finished Skating Star last week.

Uncle: Was that good?

Jade: Yes, the first bit was best. But the rest was good, too. There was a short programme about the writer on TV last week.

Uncle: Interesting.

explanations.p1q1: 图片 A 是骑自行车摔倒、B 是跑步比赛、C 是下楼梯。男孩以为她是在赛跑时摔的："you were in the running race yesterday and you nearly fell, didn’t you?"，但 Carrie 说 "actually I hurt my leg when I was coming down the stairs at home"，即腿是在家下楼时弄伤的；骑车摔倒是说话男孩自己的经历（"I hurt mine quite badly when I fell off my bike when we went cycling together"），因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q2: 图片 A 是一个大外袋、B 是两个小前袋、C 是一个大前袋（三款都有星星图案）。男孩说网上看中的款是 "one big pocket on the outside"，而他在市场买的这个 "It’s the same except it’s got two small pockets instead of one big one."，即有两个小口袋而不是一个大口袋，因此选择 B。
explanations.p1q3: 图片 A 是带花园的房子、B 是餐厅内部、C 是体育俱乐部。Daisy 说 "Mum said I should have it at the sports club because I want to invite a lot of my friends."，男孩提醒 "There isn’t a restaurant there."，最后 Daisy 说 "Mum’s agreed to do the same as last year."，即像去年一样在自家花园办，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q4: 图片 A 是办公室职员、B 是医生、C 是救护车司机。面对 "Is he a doctor?" 的询问，Dylan 回答 "He works at the hospital, but he drives an ambulance."，即爸爸现在开救护车；还说明 "He was an office worker before. He did that for a long time"，办公室是以前的旧工作，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q5: 图片 A 是冲浪、B 是帆船、C 是沙滩排球。男孩问 "Why didn’t you come sailing?"，女孩说 "I loved going surfing."，男孩也说 "That was the best thing for me, too."，可见两人昨天都去冲浪了；帆船没去成、沙滩排球只是下次的约定（"Shall we play beach volleyball next time?"），因此选择 A。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 5.60。女士让家长本周交费："Tell your parents they need to pay for the trip this week. It’s five pounds sixty."，并解释 "That’s three pounds for the ticket and the rest is for transport."，即费用是五镑六十便士（3 镑门票 + 2.60 镑交通），故填 5.60。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 Sat（Saturday）。女士说 "This trip’s on a Saturday. We don’t want you to miss a school day, like a Friday."，为了不占用上学的日子，旅行安排在周六举行，故填 Sat；Friday 只是她举例的学校日，不是出行日。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 9:10。女士要求 "Please get to school by eight fifty at the latest because the bus will go at ten past nine exactly."，即最迟 8:50 到校、巴士 9:10 准时发车，出发时间填 9:10；8:50（eight fifty）是到校时间的干扰信息。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 camera。女士说 "You don’t need to bring paper or a pen, but you’ll need a camera."，纸笔不用带、相机才需要带，没有的话 "you can share with a friend"，故填 camera。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 Modana。女士说关于汽车的展览 "has just finished"，现在要看的是 "one about clothes that’s called Modana. That’s M-O-D-A-N-A."，她逐个字母拼读了展览名，故填 Modana；car 展览是已结束的干扰项。
explanations.p3q1: Nadia 说 "It’s not far, so I don’t need to take a bus. I’ll cycle because I’ll have too many heavy books to walk there."，学校不远不用坐公交，但书太重走路去不了，所以骑车去，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q2: 对话说 "My jacket’s fantastic!"（外套很棒）、"The blue shirt’s best, I think. Not boring like the trousers!"（蓝衬衫最好、不像裤子那样无聊），可见 Tom 不喜欢的是裤子，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q3: Tom 说 "Mum told me: one thousand and fifty-five."，即新学校有 1055 人，超过 1000；"Our old school only had around eight hundred." 中的 800 是旧学校人数、475 是 Nadia 小学的人数，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q4: 化学是没人上过的新课，Nadia 说 "I don’t know if I’ll like it, but I love maths, so I think I will."，她不确定会不会喜欢化学，但因为喜欢数学、所以觉得自己会喜欢，因此选择 B；至于生物课 Tom 也说 "I’m not sure. We’ll find out on our first day."，要第一天才知道。
explanations.p3q5: Nadia 说第一天 "we’ll talk to all our teachers before we go to our class"，即要和所有老师见面谈话；"In the second week, they’ll show us how to use the library. There’ll be a quiz about it."，参观图书馆和图书馆小测验都在第二周，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q1: 老师说 "I’d asked you all for ten pounds, but our group tickets are cheaper, so you only have to give me eight."，费用从 10 英镑降为 8 英镑，变化的是费用；8:30 到校、8:45 发车的时间和乘巴士前往都没变，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q2: 男孩说他在化学课上偷看手机，"Ms Clements saw me, and took it and put it in her drawer. I can’t have it back until lunchtime."，手机被老师收进抽屉、午饭时间才能拿回，即在老师的桌子里，因此选择 A；他哥哥背包里放的是数学书。
explanations.p4q3: 男孩说新靴子 "They’re the same as the ones that singer Jason Wright’s wearing in his latest video. How cool is that?"，和歌手最新视频里的同款、觉得特别酷，即因为流行；皮革还有点硬，棕色是妈妈让选的（"Mum made me have the brown ones!"），因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q4: 女孩说双打时 "the girl I was playing with never let me hit the ball. I’m so mad at her."，搭档一直不让她接球，她非常生气，还气得 "I won’t be able to sleep tonight"、连晚饭都不想吃，因此选择 A（angry）。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩说新老师 "He smiles a lot, which is great."，女孩补充 "And always wants to help you."，即总是微笑、乐于帮助学生，因此选择 B（friendly）；女孩觉得他长得像曼联球员只是长相相似，男孩说他上学时成绩不好、40 岁才当老师，与“聪明”“有名”无关。
explanations.p5q1: Jade 说 Crunch "I finished it too quickly – in an hour! I wanted to read it for days!"，一小时就读完了、本想读四天，即觉得太短，选 G（too short）。
explanations.p5q2: Jade 说 My Island "It really made me laugh a lot. I wasn’t bored reading it at all."，让她笑了很多、一点也不无聊，即有趣好笑，选 B（funny）。
explanations.p5q3: Jade 说 Dangerous Animals "it’s not scary! But it was difficult to read – there were lots of words I didn’t know."，不吓人但很多生词、读起来难，即难以理解，选 D（hard to understand）。
explanations.p5q4: Jade 说 "I also read The Invitation. I cried when I read that, especially the beginning bit."，读的时候哭了、尤其是开头部分，即让人难过，选 E（sad）。
explanations.p5q5: Jade 说 Skating Star "the first bit was best. But the rest was good, too."，开头最好、后面也不错，即开头很精彩，选 C（good beginning）。
